theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_mcr_tl_lower_bound_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (ws : ℕ → Euclid P) (w : Euclid P) (s : ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K) → Tendsto ws atTop (𝓝 w) → Continuous h → (∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 s, h ρ ≤ μs j (ball (ws j) ρ)) → ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 s, h t ≤ μ (ball w t)
